glossRu: vand [van] — water as a substance; drinking water; neutral

examples.text: Jeg har brug for et glas vand.
examples.translation: I need a glass of water. — neutral

examples.text: Er vandet varmt nok til te?
examples.translation: Is the water hot enough for tea? — neutral
We walked along the water. — neutral

examples.text: Vandet blev afbrudt i kvarteret hele morgenen.
examples.translation: The water was cut off all morning. — neutral

examples.text: Kan jeg få noget vand, tak?
examples.translation: Can I get some water, please? — neutral

examples.text: Har du vand? Jeg er meget tørstig.
examples.translation: Got any water? I'm parched. — informal

examples.text: Kommunen skal sikre uafbrudt forsyning af drikkevand.
examples.translation: The municipality shall ensure uninterrupted supply of potable water. — formal

examples.text: De testede vandet for at sikre, at det var sikkert.
examples.translation: They tested the water for safety. — neutral

examples.text: Spar vand, når du børster tænder.
examples.translation: Save water when you brush your teeth. — informal
Fresh water is important for health. — neutral
